crew.overview: High schoolers Mitsuha and Taki are complete strangers living separate lives. But one night, they suddenly switch places. Mitsuha wakes up in Taki’s body, and he in hers. This bizarre occurrence continues to happen randomly, and the two must adjust their lives around each other.
crew.title: Your Name.

details.biography:
Shoko Takimoto (滝本 祥子, Takimoto Shōko, born 6 February 1985) is a Japanese animator, animation director and character designer.

She is best known for her character desings in ORESUKI: Are you the only one who loves me?, Death March to The Parallel World Rhapsody and Armed Girl's Machiavellism.
details.name: Shoko Takimoto
